title: 第十三章 暂住变长居第十四章 三面受敌
lines: 给朱莹出了个主意，嘱咐了阿六在大门口守着，张寿却闲庭信步绕到了自家后门。推了一下见后门纹丝不动，知道是落锁了，他就看向了旁边那棵大树。
外表看上去清雅俊逸的张小郎君，竟是身手矫健地借着树干三两下爬上了树，随即攀上了自家围墙，轻轻巧巧落在后院，丝毫不在乎这一幕被人看到会惊掉多少眼珠子。
见双手蹭了不少浮灰，他还慢悠悠地去水缸舀水洗了个手，这才从中门悄悄溜进了厅堂。
发现人都聚集在前院，他堂而皇之地往主位上欣然一坐，随即自觉进入了看戏模式。
外院中此时此刻一片静悄悄。
其实，这小小的地方眼下人多到没处下脚，确确实实和赵妈妈的抱怨相符。
三匹神气活现的骏马，三个清一色行头的马奴，然后是四个衣着比湛金和流银稍稍简朴一些，年纪也明显稍小两岁，脸上有些稚气，却努力站得笔直，干净爽利的小丫头。
而刚刚正在找茬的赵妈妈身后，是两个正在阻拦她的仆妇。虽说衣着装饰都比赵妈妈简朴得多，但她们却显得更有气派一些。
而除此之外，还有上次来过的朱宏和朱宇两个护卫，以及同等身材的护卫十二人。
再加上刚刚进来和吴氏说话的朱莹，湛金流银一对大丫头，老刘头以及刘婶夫妇，守在门口没有存在感的阿六，总共将近三十号人，三匹马，怎么可能显得不挤？
张寿不禁有些犯嘀咕。虽说朱莹那乳母说话难听，可看这么多人挤在这里的架势，接大小姐回府的阵仗好大啊！
此时此刻，旁若无人进来，却只和吴氏说话的朱莹，用她明明白白的态度，让刚刚喧闹犹如集市的院子变成了鸦雀无声的课堂。相较于受宠若惊的吴氏，完全被漠视的赵妈妈那张脸上真是写满了五颜六色，精彩极了。
吴氏倒是已经有些摸着了朱莹的性格，惊觉回神后便连忙笑道：“今天午饭是千层肉饼和酸汤饺子，汤品是玉带羹，锅里还炖了莲子甜汤，你若是喜欢，饭后又或者午睡之后再吃甜的吧。”
“好。”朱莹含笑点了点头，“阿寿也回来了，那我们一会儿就先吃饭吧。”
阿寿回来了？怎么不见人影？
吴氏心中纳闷，可朱莹说得信誓旦旦，她略一思忖，到底没有质疑，便点点头道：“刚刚被这么一耽搁，包好的饺子还没来得及下锅，千层肉饼也还没煎好，我去厨房看看。”
她说着便用力一拉刘婶，把这个差点和赵妈妈吵了个天翻地覆，却似乎忘了本职工作的厨娘给硬是拽了走。至于老刘头，这个老奸巨猾的门子瞅见没自己发挥的余地，立时跟着主母和媳妇一块溜了。
直到这时候，朱莹方才转过身面对着赵国公府今天过来的诸人。在她那严厉的目光注视下，也不知道多少人低下头去。可下一刻，不经意瞥了厅堂一眼的她就发现，张寿正四平八稳地坐在主位上，发觉她看过来时，竟然还笑吟吟地对她眨了眨眼睛。
她忍不住冲着只有自己才发现的他多看了几眼，随即才收回了目光，居高临下地吩咐道：“湛金和流银是我指名让她们过来的，小红和那两匹马也是，至于外头马车上，大约是我提过的箱笼。我只要这些人和东西就够了，其他人都回去。”
赵妈妈登时再也忍不住了，她蹬蹬蹬冲上前去，带着哭腔叫道：“我的大小姐，你什么时候在这种乡野腌臜地方住过！什么见鬼的婚约，那是哄人的，你想让满京城的千金小姐都笑话你么？这要是夫人还在……”
没等她说完，朱莹就径直对她身后那两个稳如泰山的仆妇喝道：“李妈妈，江妈妈，祖母派你们两个过来，难道就是为了让我的乳母在这丢人现眼？”
眼见朱茵面色一沉，显然真生气了，赵妈妈心中一慌，一屁股就往地上坐去，口中已经是哭号了起来：“天爷哟，我伺候了那么多年夫人，千辛万苦喂养了大……”
下一刻，一团破布就把她下半截话完全给塞回了嘴里。刚刚静若处子的江妈妈此时动如脱兔，歉意地冲着朱莹屈膝一福，随即利落地反剪了赵妈妈的胳膊，直接把人拖了走。
李妈妈这才慌忙赶上前深深行礼，满脸惶恐地解释道：“大小姐见谅，赵氏带了四个人在半道上截下我们，硬跟过来的。那是在大街上，她口口声声说大小姐就是她的命根子，如何能住在外头。我们生怕在京城街头惹出事端，无奈只得带上了她。”
她说着便扫了一眼那些个护卫，顷刻之间，就只见朱宏和朱宇身后那些个彪形大汉中，有人突然暴起出手。不消一会儿，其中四个人就被剩下八个人摁在地上，堵嘴之后捆了个结结实实，随即和又惊又怒却挣扎不得的赵妈妈一块，被押出了院子。
这些事情都发生在短短一瞬间，不一会儿，刚刚还挤满了人的院子里，便空出了一大块。
看着这简直翻脸如翻书的一幕幕，张寿不由得轻轻摩挲着下巴。
他就说嘛，果然有猫腻！
听刚刚朱莹身边那个丫头说，赵妈妈今天是带人拦车，硬跟了来。如今看外头那位仆妇的手下功夫，想要阻拦这个朱莹的乳母，根本就是举手之劳，那四个护卫也不是国公府八个护卫的对手，如果真的不想带她们来，哪里还用得着刚刚朱莹发话，他们才出手把人解决？
这是想告诉朱莹，乡居生活没那么清静惬意，随时可能有讨厌的人过来打扰？
所以接下来，应该就是请这位大小姐赶紧回府去了吧？嗯，肯定是这样！
见朱莹沉着脸没做声，李妈妈这才继续说道：“大小姐您留在这，太夫人原本就不放心，如今又只留下湛金和流银，传扬出去，人家岂不是会觉得赵国公府连伺候大小姐的人手都支应不出来？”
“再者，别人能唆使大小姐您的乳母过来捣乱，指不定还会派其他人过来闹事。还请大小姐体谅太夫人苦心，除了湛金和流银，让这四个手脚勤快的小丫头做点杂事，再留下朱宇朱宏他们这些护卫，如此也能更安全些，也不至于和刚刚那样，让主人家因此受累。”
这一刻，张寿顿时简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
朱莹昨天留下，还要了一大堆东西，朱宏朱宇两个护卫没办法反对，这还能解释为大小姐太任性，他们实在没办法，所以赶快回府去禀报。
可看眼下的架势，国公府那位太夫人不但打算继续把朱莹留在他这儿，还借着刚刚那档子事增加人手，这是打算把暂住变成长居？
开什么玩笑，就算有婚约，他们也只是“未婚”夫妻，不是夫妻！
被李妈妈这样入情入理地一劝说，朱莹简直心花怒放。她从前就觉得祖母最能理解自己的心，如今看来，这何止是理解，如果祖母眼下在这儿，她恨不得抱着她高叫一声祖母万岁！
就在这时候，她听到了张寿的声音：“大小姐乡居，府上太夫人确实不放心。”
content_en:
He gave Zhu Ying an idea and asked Ah Liu to guard at the gate, but Zhang Shou strolled around to the back door of his house. After pushing it and seeing that the back door was motionless, he knew it was locked, so he looked at the big tree next to it.
Zhang Xiaolangjun, who looked elegant and handsome in appearance, actually climbed up the tree with agility and skill, using the trunk of the tree in twos and twos. Then he climbed up the wall of his house and landed in the backyard gently and skillfully. He didn't care how many eyes would pop out if he saw this scene.
Seeing that there was a lot of dust on his hands, he slowly went to the water tank to scoop water and washed his hands, and then quietly slipped into the hall through the middle door.
Finding that everyone was gathering in the front yard, he sat down on the main seat in a grand manner, and then consciously entered the theater-watching mode.
There was silence in the outer courtyard at this moment.
In fact, there are so many people in this small place that there is nowhere to stay, which is indeed in line with Zhao’s mother’s complaints.
There are three lively horses, three horse slaves dressed in uniform, and then four little girls who are slightly simpler than Zhan Jin and Liuyin, and are obviously two years younger. Their faces are a little childish, but they try to stand up straight and clean.
Behind Mother Zhao, who was looking for trouble just now, were two servants who were trying to stop her. Although their clothes and decorations are much simpler than Zhao's mother, they look more elegant.
In addition, there are two guards, Zhu Hong and Zhu Yu, who were here last time, and twelve guards of the same size.
In addition to Zhu Ying who had just come in to talk to Mrs. Wu, a pair of beautiful and handsome girls, old Liu Tou and Aunt Liu and his wife, and Ah Liu who was guarding the door with no sense of presence, there were nearly thirty people and three horses in total. How could it not seem crowded?
Zhang Shou couldn't help but murmur a little. Although Zhu Ying's wet nurse's words were unpleasant, looking at the way so many people were crowded here, the battle to take the eldest lady back home was huge!
At this moment, Zhu Ying, who seemed to be no one else but only talked to Wu, used her clear attitude to turn the courtyard, which was noisy like a market, into a silent classroom. Compared to Wu who was flattered, Mother Zhao's face was filled with colors and was completely ignored. It was wonderful.
Mrs. Wu was already somewhat familiar with Zhu Ying's character. When she came to her senses in surprise, she quickly smiled and said: "Today's lunch is Thousand Layer Meat Pancakes and Sour Soup Dumplings. The soup is Jade Belt Soup. There is also sweet lotus seed soup stewed in the pot. If you like, you can have something sweet after dinner or after a nap."
"Okay." Zhu Ying smiled and nodded, "A Shou is back too, so let's eat first."
Ah Shou is back? Why is there no one there?
Mrs. Wu was puzzled, but Zhu Ying was so steadfast in what she said. She thought about it for a moment, but she didn't question it, so she nodded and said: "I was delayed like this just now. The dumplings haven't been put into the pot yet, and the thousand-layer meatloaf hasn't been fried yet. I'll go to the kitchen to have a look."
As she spoke, she pulled Aunt Liu hard and dragged away the cook who almost had a huge quarrel with Zhao's mother but seemed to have forgotten her job. As for Old Liu Tou, this cunning disciple saw that he had no room for his own performance, so he immediately ran away with his mistress and daughter-in-law.
Only then did Zhu Ying turn around and face the people who came to Zhao Guogong's mansion today. Under her stern gaze, no one knew how many people lowered their heads. But the next moment, she casually glanced at the hall and discovered that Zhang Shouzheng was sitting steadily on the main seat. When she noticed that she looked over, he actually winked at her with a smile.
She couldn't help but look at him, whom she was the only one who noticed. Then she withdrew her gaze and commanded condescendingly: "Zhanjin and Liuyin were sent by me, as were Xiaohong and the two horses. As for the carriage outside, there are probably boxes and cages that I have carried. I only need these people and things, and everyone else should go back."
Mother Zhao couldn't bear it anymore. She rushed forward and shouted in a tearful voice: "My eldest lady, when did you ever live in such a dirty place in the countryside! What the hell is an engagement? It's deceiving. Do you want all the rich ladies in the capital to laugh at you? If Madam is still here..."
Before she could finish speaking, Zhu Ying shouted directly to the two steady servants behind her: "Mother Li, Mother Jiang, grandma sent you two here just to embarrass my wet nurse here?"
Seeing Zhu Yin's face darken, she was obviously really angry. Mother Zhao panicked and sat down on the ground, already crying: "Oh my God, I have served my wife for so many years, and I have worked hard to feed the baby..."
The next moment, a ball of rags completely stuffed the second half of her words back into her mouth. Mother Jiang, who had just been as quiet as a virgin, was now moving like a rabbit. She bowed apologetically to Zhu Ying, then neatly cut off Mother Zhao's arm and dragged her away.
Mother Li hurriedly rushed forward, bowed deeply, and explained with fear on her face: "Miss Zhao, please forgive me, Mrs. Zhao led four people to intercept us halfway and follow us. That was on the street. She kept saying that the eldest daughter was her lifeblood, how could she live outside. We were afraid of causing trouble on the streets of the capital, so we had no choice but to take her with us."
As she spoke, she glanced at the guards. In an instant, she saw someone among the burly men behind Zhu Hong and Zhu Yu suddenly taking action. After a while, four of them were pushed to the ground by the remaining eight, gagged and tied up tightly, and then they were escorted out of the yard together with Mother Zhao, who was frightened and angry but unable to struggle.
All these things happened in a short moment. After a while, a large area of ​​​​the courtyard that was crowded with people just now became empty.
Seeing this scene that turned his head like a book, Zhang Shou couldn't help but rub his chin gently.
He just said that there is indeed something fishy!
I heard the girl next to Zhu Ying just now say that Mother Zhao led someone to stop the car today and followed her. Now looking at the hard work of the servant girl outside, it is just a piece of cake to stop Zhu Ying's wet nurse. Those four guards are no match for the eight guards of the Duke's Mansion. If they really don't want to bring them here, why do they need Zhu Ying to say something before they take action?
Do you want to tell Zhu Ying that life in the countryside is not so quiet and comfortable, and annoying people may come and disturb you at any time?
So the next step should be to ask this young lady to go back home quickly, right? Well, that’s definitely the case!
Seeing that Zhu Ying had a sullen face and remained silent, Mother Li continued: "Miss, please stay here. Madam Tai was worried at first. Now that she has only left pure gold and liquid silver to spread the word, wouldn't people think that Duke Zhao's mansion can't even provide the manpower to serve the eldest lady?"
"Furthermore, others can instigate the eldest lady, your wet nurse, to come and make trouble, and they may send other people to make trouble. Please eldest lady, please understand the madam's painstaking efforts. In addition to Zhan Jin and Liuyin, let these four hard-working little girls do some chores, and leave Zhu Yu, Zhu Hong and the others as guards. This will be safer, and the master will not be troubled like just now."
At this moment, Zhang Shou couldn't believe his ears.
Zhu Ying stayed yesterday and asked for a lot of things. The two guards Zhu Hong and Zhu Yu could not object. This can also be explained as the eldest lady was too willful. They really had no choice, so they hurried back to report.
But looking at the current situation, the lady in the Duke's Mansion not only plans to keep Zhu Ying at his place, but also uses the incident just now to increase the manpower. Is she planning to turn her temporary residence into a permanent residence?
Are you kidding me? Even if they are engaged, they are only an "unmarried" couple, not husband and wife!
Zhu Ying was so happy to be persuaded by Mrs. Li in such a considerate manner. She used to feel that her grandmother could understand her heart best, but now it seems that this is more than understanding. If her grandmother were here now, she could not wait to hug her and shout "long live grandma!"
At this time, she heard Zhang Shou's voice: "The eldest lady lives in the country, and the lady in the house is really worried."
title_en: Chapter 13: Temporary residence becomes permanent residence Chapter 14: Enemies on three sides
